verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video generation platform, since vendors in this category could release weights or on-prem deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only Kling's hosted RESTful API at its own Singapore and Beijing endpoints, purchased credits, and third-party API resellers. Nothing shows self-hostable software or downloadable models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
